integrity: The exact path block theorem and its original authors are explicitly credited; this claim is restricted to cycles. Exact computation corroborates but does not prove the all-n result.
scientific_limitations: The result covers only canonical normalized induced-distance utilities on simple unweighted cycles, not general unicyclic networks, weighted networks or unnormalized scoring; source-priority uncertainty persists in unindexed literature.
title: Complete welfare and optimal-partition counts on cyclic social-distance networks
